OneNoteは何の箱なのか――Think of it as a binder plus an infinite canvas

OneNote is hard to grasp if we call it only a note-taking app. Microsoft’s own model is closer to a searchable three-ring binder, while each page behaves like an infinite canvas. This essay separates those two layers and turns them into a practical rule: Notebook as boundary, Section as durable category, and Page as one event, question, research task, or deliverable.
